test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the sentence that uses the homonym of the underlined word:

The __**wind**__ howled through the trees.

options.text: The wind was cold and sharp at night.
The wind knocked over the garbage can.
A sudden gust of wind blew her hat away.
He had to wind the old clock manually.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"wind"** in the original sentence refers to the natural movement of air. (हवा)
 
 
• **Example: **The wind howled through the trees, creating an eerie sound.
 
 
 
• The correct homonym **"wind"** refers to the act of twisting or turning something, such as winding a clock. (घुमाना)
 
 
• **Example: **He had to wind the old clock manually to make it work.
 
 
 
• Both words are spelled the same, but their meanings and pronunciation differ depending on the context.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: The wind was cold and sharp at night.** (हवा ठंडी और तेज़ थी) - This sentence uses "wind" in the same context as the original sentence, referring to air in motion.
 
 
• **Example:** The wind was so strong that it chilled everyone to the bone.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: The wind knocked over the garbage can.** (हवा ने कूड़ेदान गिरा दिया) - This also uses "wind" in the same context as moving air.
 
 
• **Example:** The wind blew fiercely, scattering trash across the yard.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: A sudden gust of wind blew her hat away.** (हवा के तेज़ झोंके ने उसकी टोपी उड़ा दी) - This again refers to air movement, similar to the original sentence.
 
 
• **Example:** The wind gust caught her off guard and she lost her hat.
